findings.statement: The package-shape check noted that no gatekeeper-build verdict existed when its precheck ran. This is the current initial submission, and this gate is now writing the required verdict record at the canonical path.

The test report retains a sentence saying health-check must refresh runtime evidence before build submission. The r269 production smoke, runtime report, and typed runtime probe already provide that refresh and pass on the same source hashes, so this is stale report wording rather than a missing runtime result. The note should be clarified in a future report-only update; it does not require rerunning tests or runtime validation.
